name: COLONEL FANSHAWE
note: FANSHAWE IN THE STREET, waiting, pleased with himself; he calls the duel (Main Street's accost). Doc 57 F4: 'The first time Thad steps onto the street after T_ASSAY_RUN, Fanshawe is waiting with half the town and the judges' table on the boardwalk, Sowerby holding the pencil.' Cut from room-02 operations 1 and 2 by tools/art/room02-duel-cast.py and laid over Room 2's own street. Present for the visit the duel is called on (T_DUEL_CROWD), and gone the next time.
barksNote: The duel is spoken through the assay (content/assay/assay.json).

sprite.frameNote: 0 thumbs in his waistcoat, turned to Thad · 1 breath (derived) · 2 a hand held out · 3 the watch · 4 tipping his hat.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 T (Tyler, 2026-11-06: no table at Duel Three; the gathering composed as one picture). Drawn standing on magenta from the locked cast master by cast-unify operation 28 (reference/cast-unify-26.txt), turned toward the duel, cut with its own pixels and a clean edge; placed where the painted composition (cast-unify 27, art/staging/cast-unify/batch-25/edit-porch.png) stood him, feet on the boards or the street, drawn at the street's man there.
sprite.figureHeightNote: ERRATA 235 (Tyler, 2026-11-09: everyone within 3% of Thad). Crown to sole under his top hat, read from his eyes and chin: 364. Was 352 (tools/art/figure-height.py --hat, which counted his collar as the brim): 1.03 of Thad.
sprite.levelManNote: ERRATA 235: the man its sheet was snapped to one level at (errata 112 G), kept while it is drawn at its new height without a re-snap; the drift is held to 5% (tests/one-level.test.mjs).

walkToNote: Facing him across the street, as the master stood them.
facesNote: Toward the duel: Fanshawe and Thad below, Thad to the right. Measured on the rest frame by tests/faces.test.mjs.

leaves.note: Doc 03: "He walks back up the street to his office, and for the first time in twelve years, he closes the door." Errata 131 F: he has no walk (errata 99 N), so he fades, and the door closes off the frame once he has gone.
